name: agent-commerce-analytics-template
description: Merchant-facing analytics for AI shopping agents. Tracks the discover → browse → purchase journey per agent, payment network, and verification status, with auto-generated insights and a React dashboard.

MERCHANT_NAME.description: Your store name, shown in the dashboard header (e.g., 'Mountain Kids Outfitters').

SEED_DEMO_DATA.description: Seed bundled demo traffic on first request so the dashboard is populated out of the box. Set to `false` once you're ingesting real events.

EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days of agent events to retain in KV (default: 30).

scripts.check: tsc && vp build && wrangler deploy --dry-run && vp check
